notes.title: Potato Game AirDrop Challenge
notes.notes:
Earn free potatoes by playing Runes of Mystery! Here’s how to get yours:

Log in to Your Runes of Mystery Account: Access the game through the Runes of Mystery login screen. If you don’t have an account yet, register now and join the adventure!

Level Up Your Character: Progress through the game by leveling up your character. Every level you reach brings you closer to earning those free potatoes.

Claim Your Free Potatoes: After reaching a new level milestone, log out and return to the Potato Game AirDrop system. Mention your newly achieved level here, and your free potatoes will be delivered to you!

Note: Potatoes are usually sold in the in-game shop, but by participating in this event, you can get them for free. The more you play, the more you earn. Don’t forget to visit Runes of Mystery for more details and to start your journey.

Enjoy the game and happy leveling!

Crafting System Added to Potato Game

A new feature has been added to the Potato game: the Crafting System. This system allows players to combine the potatoes they collect to create various crafting items. The crafting system aims to enhance creativity and strategy while increasing the depth and playability of the game.

Features:

Potato Collection: Players can gather different types of potatoes in the game world. These potatoes are categorized and used in crafting recipes.
Potato Combining: Players can combine the collected potatoes to craft various items. Each type of potato offers unique properties and combinations.
New Crafting Items: Items crafted from potatoes enrich the players' in-game experience and enable them to develop new strategies. These items include tools, weapons, and other useful objects.
Game Depth: This new system encourages players to spend more time in the game world and increases in-game interactions.
With this new feature, the Potato game aims to provide players with a more comprehensive and enjoyable experience. Players can use the potatoes they collect to create innovative crafting items and shape their own stories within the game world.
